functions.name: NotifyShaderCompiled
functions.signature: NotifyShaderCompiled(Target, Platform Symbol Data, Debug Info)
functions.docs:
Should be called from IShaderFormat::NotifyShaderCompiled implementation.
Template type is the platform specific symbol data structure.

functions.name: NotifyShaderCompilersShutdown
functions.docs: Called at the end of a cook to free resources and finalize artifacts created during the cook.

functions.name: NotifyShaderCompiled
functions.signature: NotifyShaderCompiled(Target, Platform Symbol Data Compressed, Debug Info)
functions.docs:
If true, the current process is the first process in a multiprocess group, or is not in a group,
and should combine artifacts produced by the other processes. Will also be false if no combination
is necessary for given settings.
